title: Academic Calendar Spring 2026 Released
content: The university senate has officially published the Spring 2026 academic calendar. Midterms begin April 10.

title: Midterm Examination Schedule & Seating Plan
content: All students are advised to check the examination portal for individual hall tickets and assigned seating halls.

title: Annual Techfest - Innovate 2026 Call for Entries
content: Registrations are now live for hackathons, robotics challenges, and paper presentations at Innovate 2026.

title: Campus Placement Drive: Google India & Microsoft
content: Final year and pre-final year students eligible for cloud engineering profiles are requested to upload resumes.

title: Library Extended Hours During Examination Week
content: The central digital library will remain open 24x7 starting next Monday to facilitate exam revision.

title: Fee Payment Deadline for Semester 2
content: Late fee charges of ₹500 will apply to tuition payments received after May 15, 2026.

title: Hostel Maintenance & Wi-Fi Upgrade Notice
content: High-speed Wi-Fi 6 access points are being configured across Aryabhata and Sarojini hostels.

title: Inter-Departmental Cricket & Football Tournament
content: Teams are invited to register at the student sports council office by February 25.

title: Workshop on Generative AI & Cloud Kubernetes
content: Hands-on practical session hosted by Department of Computer Science & Engineering.

content: Morning departure from Noida Sector 62 is preponed by 15 minutes due to expressway roadwork.

content: Corporate internship guidelines for 2nd and 3rd year students are now available on the portal.
